about.description:
The timezone boundary dataset that `timezonefinder` looks timezones up in,
split out of that package at its 8.3.0 release so that a new dataset can
ship without a new `timezonefinder` release.

The data derives from evansiroky/timezone-boundary-builder and is licensed
under the ODbL, which is not the licence of `timezonefinder` itself.
about.summary: The packaged timezone boundary data for the timezonefinder package

script: ${{ PYTHON }} -c "import shutil, zipfile; w='timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}-py3-none-any.whl'; shutil.copyfileobj(zipfile.ZipFile(w).open('timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}.dist-info/licenses/DATA_LICENSE'), open('DATA_LICENSE', 'wb'))"

script.content:
from importlib.resources import files

data = files("timezonefinder_data") / "data"
for name in (
    "timezone_names.txt",
    "hole_registry.json",
    "boundaries/coordinates.bin",
):
    assert (data / name).is_file(), name

name: timezonefinder-data
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.2026.3.post1"

package:
  name: timezonefinder-data
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # The released wheel, not the tag archive. Upstream stopped committing the
  # dataset at the 3.x format generation ("the dataset is git-ignored" -
  # .github/workflows/compile_data.yml): it is compiled in CI and the wheel that
  # run produces is what the `data-v*` tag publishes. The tag archive therefore
  # carries only the four source files, and building from it would produce a
  # wheel with no dataset in it - which installs cleanly and fails at the first
  # lookup. No sdist is published for any release of this distribution, so the
  # wheel is the only artefact that contains the data.
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/py3/t/timezonefinder-data/timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}-py3-none-any.whl
  file_name: timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}-py3-none-any.whl
  sha256: d71b3814362e69cb208f8d30249efe2fa0d2cd55579679c5ae1727cd38840606

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}-py3-none-any.whl -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    # `license_file` below needs the licence as a file in the work directory;
    # installing a wheel only ever puts it inside the prefix.
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -c "import shutil, zipfile; w='timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}-py3-none-any.whl'; shutil.copyfileobj(zipfile.ZipFile(w).open('timezonefinder_data-${{ version }}.dist-info/licenses/DATA_LICENSE'), open('DATA_LICENSE', 'wb'))"

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - timezonefinder_data
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  # The package is its payload, so this looks for the payload. An import test
  # alone passes on the empty build described above.
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      interpreter: python
      content: |-
        from importlib.resources import files

        data = files("timezonefinder_data") / "data"
        for name in (
            "timezone_names.txt",
            "hole_registry.json",
            "boundaries/coordinates.bin",
        ):
            assert (data / name).is_file(), name

about:
  summary: The packaged timezone boundary data for the timezonefinder package
  description: |
    The timezone boundary dataset that `timezonefinder` looks timezones up in,
    split out of that package at its 8.3.0 release so that a new dataset can
    ship without a new `timezonefinder` release.

    The data derives from evansiroky/timezone-boundary-builder and is licensed
    under the ODbL, which is not the licence of `timezonefinder` itself.
  license: ODbL-1.0
  license_file: DATA_LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/jannikmi/timezonefinder
  repository: https://github.com/jannikmi/timezonefinder
  documentation: https://timezonefinder.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jannikmi
    - xylar
